item.title: Okayama with Kids: Momotaro Shrines, Castle Views & Bizen Pottery
item.description: Okayama has an unusual advantage as a family destination: it is the birthplace of Momotaro, the Peach Boy who is arguably the most famous character in Japanese folklore. Every child in Japan grows up with the story of the boy born from a giant peach who recruits a dog, a monkey, and a pheasant as companions and goes to defeat the demons of Onigashima Island. In Okayama, this is not merely a story.
